Cara: DeployBot: lock-lease pressure on migration mig_5890 during quiet-cutover at 04:22 UTC. Auto-quiesce engaged.
DeployBot: [deploybot] LEASE_PRESSURE mig_5890 shard=shard-02 inflight=19/22 renew_fail=3
Devon: seeing elevated HW queue depth and pg_lock timeouts on tenant_idx. We should avoid full rollback if possible.
Elena: runbook suggests: try in-place handoff -> selective snapshot -> pause if handoff fails. Link: https://confluence.redwood/internal/runbooks/migrations#mig_5890
Finn: +1. Also let's pin the migration tool to tag `infra/mig-hotpatch-1.16.0` before any owner swap to avoid mixed behavior.
Cara: decision: attempt in-place handoff to worker-hotstandby-5. If handoff fails within 10s, perform selective pause tenants 800-840, take KV prefix snapshot, then decide on extend vs rollback. Rollback thresholds: lease lost >45s OR inflight >24.
Devon: initiating handoff: ```deploybot handoff mig_5890 --to worker-hotstandby-5 --actor devon```
DeployBot: HANDOFF_START mig_5890 -> worker-hotstandby-5 at 6155551241
DeployBot: HANDOFF_FAIL mig_5890 reason="tcp timeout" at 6155551244
Elena: handoff failed. executing selective pause for tenants 800-840 now.
Devon: ```deploybot pause mig_5890 --tenants 800-840 --actor devon --reason "handoff fail"``` -> acked
DeployBot: SELECTIVE_PAUSE_ACK mig_5890 tenants=800-840 by devon at 6155551248
Finn: starting KV prefix snapshot (runtime hook). ETA ~60s. tagging runbook and adding checksum post.
DeployBot: snapshot_status mig_5890 tenants=800-840 status=done checksum=sha256:7b2c9d
Cara: snapshot OK. applying pin: infra/mig-hotpatch-1.16.0 -> ReleaseBot, please pin note.
ReleaseBot: [releasebot] NOTE_PINNED mig_5890 tag=infra/mig-hotpatch-1.16.0 by finn
Devon: probe extend 20s to see if leases can renew: ```deploybot extend mig_5890 --secs 20 --actor devon```
DeployBot: EXTEND_OK mig_5890 at 6155551265
Elena: extend succeeded. we'll resume the affected tenants at a conservative 10% ratecap.
Devon: ```deploybot ratecap mig_5890 --tenants 800-840 --fraction 0.10 --actor devon``` -> acked
DeployBot: RATECAP_SET mig_5890 tenants=800-840 fraction=0.10 at 6155551270
Finn: adding to release notes draft: "mig_5890: selective pause after handoff fail; KV snapshot taken; extended leases succeeded; resumed at 10%; pinned infra/mig-hotpatch-1.16.0; monitoring."
Cara: leaving postmortem stub and telemetry links. OncallBot, please remind us to notify account teams if rollback becomes necessary.
OncallBot: Reminder: if rollback occurs, follow rollback-hatch checklist and page account teams early.
Devon: monitoring heap and lock counters for next 15m. closing thread after 15m stable. :eyes:
